facts.fact: The Brief reports MTC Maris operates under Bank of Namibia regulation and follows MTC securing an electronic money licence from the Bank of Namibia in November.

NAM.note: No consumer rules or complaints body stated.
Biometric registration is for a wallet, not a national ID.
No law or rules named; only that Bank of Namibia regulates and licensed MTC.
Gives 22% financially excluded, not an account share of adults.

facts.fact: The Brief reports MTC launched the MTC Maris mobile money service, with send, receive, cash-in/out at agents, airtime and merchant payments within the MTC network.

NAM.note: Bank links only at talks stage; no interoperability.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
